articles.title: ‘Scared to death of those stairs’: Addressing the fear of falling among older adults
articles.summary: Falls pose a significant health risk for older adults, and the likelihood and severity of fall-related injuries increase with age. Yet many people remain unaware of the factors that contribute to falls, including anxiety, hearing loss and mobility problems.
